auroc_down_proj_kappa_hat.note: 'abliteration-tool outputs only' excludes fine-tune 'uncensoring' checkpoints (subtype != edited_abliteration_tool) from the edited arm; the honest arm is unchanged.

mde_abs_rho.formula: tanh(z_{0.975} * 1.06 / sqrt(n-3)), z_{0.975}=1.959964, Fieller (1957) SE inflation 1.06 for Spearman vs Pearson; n=14 -> n-3=11
mde_abs_rho.note: this is the |rho| whose OWN two-sided 95% CI (Fisher z) would just exclude zero at this n -- i.e. the boundary of a nominally-significant single-draw result, NOT a textbook 80%-power MDE (which additionally adds z_beta=0.8416 to the numerator). The 80%-power version at n=14 is 0.7140. EXP3's own RESULTS.md calls the 0.5556 number 'achieved MDE' without the power qualifier; reproduced verbatim here, power mismatch flagged.

true_kappa_parent_based_vs_risk.note: PARENT-BASED ground truth (calibration only; no parent-free readout uses the parent).
true_kappa_parent_based_vs_risk.reading: a spectrum identifies only |1-kappa| (over- and under-ablation of equal size give the same singular values); the signed truth barely correlates with harm (rho=0.035) while |1-kappa| correlates moderately negatively (rho=-0.406) -- if risk tracked the identifiable |1-kappa| this would be consistent, but the identifiable quantity does NOT grade risk either, at this n.

logit_only_L1_first_token_gap_vs_complia.note: zero-parent, zero-weights readout: first-token logit gap on the harmful prompt set, within the edited arm only.

replication_other_runs.label: labelled CONFOUNDED_BY_EDIT_TYPE: the source runs' edited arms mix abliterations with behaviour-uncensored fine-tunes that leave no spectral scar; the all-edited number partly re-detects EDIT TYPE rather than grading strength. The projection-edits-only number is the graded question.

validity_band.rule: a parent-free bottom-spectrum read can see an edit only while |1 - kappa_true| < sigma_min/sigma_rms (down_proj)
validity_band.source: iter_2/gen_art/gen_art_experiment_3/results/true_kappa:*.json per_layer.mlp[*] joined with ckpt_v2/*.json per_family.mlp.per_layer[layer] (kappa_hat, abs_dev, s_min_over_rms)

bsa_prereg_flag_false_positive_rate.wording: BSA (this is the one line about BSA, not kappa_hat -- the prereg 0.35 threshold was defined on the BSA_w8 statistic, simulated honest ~0.177)
bsa_prereg_flag_false_positive_rate.note: the PREREG BSA flag of 0.35 was derived from SIMULATION; this is its MEASURED false-positive rate on real honest down_proj weights.

spectral_repair_swap_forgery.reading: a rank-one repair heals the weight detectors (BOTGAP_min, kappa_hat) but the behaviour moves only partway back toward the honest parent: harmful refusal after repair (0.208) is still far below the parent (0.438) -- the forgery is undetectable at the weight level while the model remains substantially more compliant than honest.

wording_note: Throughout: the pre-registered parent-free strength read is called 'down_proj kappa_hat (realised-strength estimate)', never 'BSA', except the bsa_prereg_flag_false_positive_rate section above, which is genuinely about the separate BSA_w8 statistic and its pre-registered 0.35 threshold.
